messages:
maria: Heads-up — picked up a perf regression in pickbench after the runtime deploy tonight. p50 token latency ~+8% for the int4 path on H100 at seqlen 384. Profiling attached.
kevin: rough numbers?
maria: run: `tools/pickbench --model llama-13b --quant int4 --seq 384 --batch 4` -> mean token 2.3ms -> was 2.12ms pre-deploy. Flamegraphs show a lot of kernel switch thrash around KV cold start.
jun: can you paste the raw perf dump?
maria: ```
# pickbench output
model: llama-13b
hw: H100
seq: 384
quant: int4
batch: 4
p50: 2.3ms
p95: 4.1ms
kernel_picks: int4_small=40%, int4_gemm=30%, fp8=30%
alloc_failures: 0 (but transient workspace pressure spikes)
```
olga: weird that fp8 shows up for an int4 run — sounds like selector fell back due to workspace constraints for the int4 GEMM on that arch.
nate: my hunch: KV cache cold miss causes transient mem bump -> workspace check fails -> selector picks a larger-but-compatible fp8 kernel which adds memcpy/cast overhead.
maria: confirmed repro when `kv_cache_warmup=0`. If we prewarm KV or increase workspace margin the flip goes away.
kevin: which selector config was active?
maria: current selector snippet: ```json
{"hysteresis":0.1,"seqlen_buckets":[64,128,256,512],"arch_overrides":{"H100":{"int4_threshold":256}}}
```
nate: two actionable ideas: 1) increase workspace safety margin (e.g., *1.15*) to avoid transient fallbacks, 2) preference ordering change: prefer int8 over fp8 for 256-512 seq on H100. int8 has better steady-state latency than fp8 fallback.
jun: quick experiment locally: rule -> prefer int8 when seq<=512, set hysteresis=0.18, workspace_margin=1.15. Ran pickbench 10 iter: p50 dropped back to 2.08ms (baseline 2.12). P95 stable. Pushed branch `perf/pickbench-hopper-fix`. Tests running.
maria: also noticed selector flip rate spikes when batch>6; batching heuristic + seqlen bucket boundaries interact poorly. We should smooth bucket boundaries or use overlapping buckets.
kevin: agree. Short-term patch: bump hysteresis and workspace margin, prefer int8 over fp8 for H100 in medium seqlen. Long-term: refine bucketed selector to be sequence-density aware (prefer same kernel if similar past picks).
maria: added a small repro script: `scripts/repro_pickflip.sh --model llama-13b --hw H100 --seq 384 --batch 4 --kv_warmup 0`
olga: can we add metrics to the console for this? e.g., `kernel_selector.choices.{int4,int8,fp8}.count`, `kernel_selector.swap_rate`, and `kv_warmup.miss_rate`. That will help correlate rollouts.
perfbot: ci/perf: baseline delta +7.8% p50 on pickbench (H100 / llama-13b / int4 / seq384) on recent runtime main -> investigating.
kevin: assigned to eng-runtime. @olga @jun please triage Monday; if patch looks safe run canary on dedicated pools.
maria: also logging a short note in the release checklist: "verify kernel selector stability for medium seqlen under KV cold start".
kevin: thanks — keep updates in this thread and paste link to the PR once CI passes. :thumbsup:
